question: Which of the following Indian players won two Olympic medals in a single edition of the Games in Paris 2025 and was awarded with Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manu Bhaker**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Manu Bhaker** achieved a historic feat by winning two Olympic medals in shooting during the Paris 2024 Olympics.
 
• She became the first Indian woman shooter to secure two medals in a single Olympic edition.
 
• Her outstanding performance in the 10m Air Pistol and Mixed Team Shooting events earned her global recognition.
 
• In January 2025, Minu Bhaker was awarded the prestigious **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award** for her exceptional achievements in sports.
 
• Minu Bhaker's journey symbolizes dedication, perseverance, and the rising dominance of Indian women in shooting sports on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swapnil Suresh Kusale**

 
 
• Swapnil Kusale is an Indian professional shooter specializing in rifle events such as the 50m Rifle 3 Positions.
 
• He has represented India in various international competitions, including ISSF World Cups and Asian Championships.
 
• Despite his talent and contributions to Indian shooting, he has not won two Olympic medals in a single edition of the Games.
 
 
 
• **Sarabjot Singh**
 
 
• Sarabjot Singh is an emerging talent in Indian shooting, particularly in the 10m Air Pistol category.
 
• He has secured medals in ISSF Junior World Cups and other international tournaments.
 
• Although he has shown great potential, he did not achieve the historic milestone of two Olympic medals in Paris 2024.
 
 
 
• **Manu Bhaker**
 
 
• Manu Bhaker is one of India's most accomplished shooters, having won numerous medals in ISSF World Cups and Youth Olympics.
 
• She competes in events such as the 10m Air Pistol and 25m Pistol categories.
 
• While she has been a prominent figure in Indian shooting, the feat of winning two Olympic medals in Paris 2024 was achieved by Minu Bhaker.
